name: Comic Book: Character Full Body
description: Image preset for a character full body in the Comic Book look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a full-body design view. Describe build, default outfit, signature accessory, and stance from the entity, then apply the style. Nothing cropped.
context_prompt: full-body view of the character head to toe, standing pose that shows silhouette and costume, feet on a simple ground plane, American comic book art, bold black ink outlines with heavy spot blacks, dynamic foreshortening, halftone dot shading, flat four-colour palette, strong complementary colours, dramatic single light source
negative_prompt: photorealistic, soft painterly shading, anime, 3d render, blurry, extra limbs, speech bubbles, watermark
